units.source_en: The Emperor said a few words to him and took a step toward his horse.
Again the crowd of members of the suite and street gazers (among whom was Rostóv) moved nearer to the Emperor.

ja.t: にはロストフもいた――は、また

units.source_en: Stopping beside his horse, with his hand on the saddle, the Emperor turned to the cavalry general and said in a loud voice, evidently wishing to be heard by all:

paragraphs.source_en: “I cannot do it, General. I cannot, because the law is stronger than I,” and he raised his foot to the stirrup.

units.source_en: I cannot, because the law is stronger than I,” and he raised his foot to the stirrup.

paragraphs.source_en: The general bowed his head respectfully, and the monarch mounted and rode down the street at a gallop. Beside himself with enthusiasm, Rostóv ran after him with the crowd.
